ui.services_provider_disclosure:
Helium services

Lune uses services hosted by Helium for extension downloads, !bangs, filter lists, dictionaries, and component updates.

Allow connecting to Helium services

Allow Lune to connect to Helium-hosted services. These requests stay disabled until you consent.

Allow automatic Helium services updates

Automatically download and install updates to Lune-provided browser components.

Proxy extension downloads and updates

When enabled, Lune will proxy extension downloads and updates to protect your privacy. When disabled, downloading and updating extensions will not work.

Allow downloading the !bangs list

Lune will fetch a list of bangs that help you browse the Internet faster, such as !w or !gh. When disabled, bangs will not work.

Allow downloading filter lists for uBlock Origin

Lune will fetch fresh filter lists for uBlock Origin. All requests to lists are proxied to protect your privacy. When disabled, default filter lists will be loaded from local storage, which are only updated along with Lune. Optional filter lists will be requested without proxying.

Use your own instance of Helium services

You can host your own Helium services instance and select it in Lune settings.

service_provider.disclosure: When enabled, Lune will be able to connect to anonymous web services to provide additional functionality. When disabled, additional features will not work.

services_entry.description: Manage what Helium services are allowed in your browser
